x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.guidance_text: Card-not-present fraud is eligible for chargeback under network rules (reason code fraud/no-authorization). Collect device, IP, and AVS/CVV mismatch evidence. Observe network filing deadlines (typically 120 days).
x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.keywords: CNP, chargeback, reason code, AVS, CVV, network deadline
